content: The NPL4 (Nuclear Protein Localization Protein 4) homolog is a protein encoded by the NPL4 gene in humans. Model organisms have been utilized to investigate the function of NPL4. A conditional knockout mouse line, named Nploc4tm1a(EUCOMM)Wtsi, was developed as part of the International Knockout Mouse Consortium program. This program is a high-throughput mutagenesis initiative aimed at creating and distributing animal models of human diseases to researchers. The mouse line was generated at the Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute. Both male and female mice underwent a standardized phenotypic screening process to assess the effects of NPL4 gene deletion. A total of 26 tests were conducted, and two phenotypes were reported. Notably, no homozygous mutant embryos were detected during gestation, and as a result, none survived to the weaning stage. The remaining tests were performed on heterozygous mutant adult mice, and no significant abnormalities were observed in these animals. Regarding protein interactions, NPL4 has been demonstrated to interact with UFD1L.
